title: A rename ended by a press on another item selects the renamed item again, so the menu just opened acts on the wrong file
problem:
Found by the review of the whole branch (20 Nov), in which one reviewer read all the improvements together through one lens and a second reviewer tried to refute each finding against the code. Nothing was run in that review: every finding was traced by reading. [rename-ended-by-press-reselects-renamed-item] A rename ended by a press on another item selects the renamed item again a moment later; after a right-click, the open menu acts on the renamed item, not the one it names (new in the column view, inherited in list and icons). The finder's scenario: Steps (list, icon or column view; not run, traced in the code): 1) select notes.txt, press F2, type a different valid name (say plan). 2) Without pressing Return, right-click another item, Roadmap.md. What happens: the press ends the edit and renames the file; Roadmap.md is selected and its menu opens, reading Cut "Roadmap.md", Copy "Roadmap.md", Compress "Roadmap.md". A few milliseconds later the reload that the rename asked for ends and selects plan.txt instead (the highlight jumps; Roadmap.md is deselected). The menu stays open. Every action item in it (Open, Quick Look, Get Info, Rename…, Duplicate, Cut, Copy, Copy Path, Compress, Move to Trash) reads the selection when it is chosen, so Move to Trash trashes plan.txt, the file just renamed, and Open opens it. Same with a left click followed by a key: click Roadmap.md to end the edit, press Cmd+Backspace, and plan.txt goes to the Trash. Expected: the item pressed stays selected and the menu acts on the item it names. The name must really change: an unchanged name returns before the reload (dialogs.rs:852-854). In the column view this is new with 7e8df53: before it the reload only set the rows' selection, which the column view does not read, so the column kept the right-clicked row. It now happens in the first column (select_row_in_columns) and in a further column (load_column's `wanted`). A further variant there: ending a rename in column 1 by clicking its parent folder's grey row in column 0 puts the column in use back on column 1 with the renamed file selected. The column-pane record lists only 'leaves the renamed item selected, not the clicked one' under left_out; the menu acting on another item than it names is not recorded, and nothing of it is in final-pass-notes.md. The code path: src/finder/inline_rename.rs:262-266 (the field's on_mouse_down_out, capture phase, any button) -> leave_rename :145-156 -> finish_rename :123-139 -> src/finder/dialogs.rs:825-889 submit_rename, which at :884-887 calls load_listing(vec![target], true, cx) and renamed_in_columns(path, target, cx). Same press, bubble phase: src/finder/views.rs:488-493 -> src/finder/mod.rs:2677-2685 right_click_row selects the pressed row (it has no check of a rename, and by then `renaming` is None); in columns views.rs:1300-1312 -> select_in_column. The kit then builds the menu in window.defer (gpui-component-0.8.1 src/menu/context_menu.rs:396-405 and :462) from src/finder/menus.rs:129-130 `finder.selected_entries()`, so its labels name the pressed item. Later the listing task ends: src/finder/mod.rs:1545-1557 rebuilds the rows, then `this.selection.select_only(first)` for the renamed path and `select_row_in_columns(first, cx)` (mod.rs:4050-4056 -> select_in_column_quiet(0, ix)). Further column: mod.rs:4062-4072 renamed_in_columns computes `select` before the press selects, and load_column's completion at mod.rs:4113-4119 runs `select_in_column_quiet(col, ix)` because `wanted` differs from `kept` (the row just pressed); that also sets active_column = col and truncates the columns after it (mod.rs:4020-4023). Menu commands read the selection when chosen: src/finder/menus.rs:322-326 Move to Trash -> src/finder/trash.rs:26-45 `self.selected_entries()`; mod.rs:3013-3026 open_selected. The second reviewer, who tried to refute it and confirmed it, corrects the scenario: As the finder wrote it, with three precisions.

1. The menu stays on screen only while the right-clicked row is still under the pressed point after the reload: context_menu.rs:358 `draws_menu.set(bounds.contains(&position))`. That is the usual case; the finder's notes.txt -> plan.txt keeps Roadmap.md at the same row. If the new name sorts across the pressed row, or `scroll_to(first)` scrolls the list, the kit stops drawing the menu and the focus-lost net gives the files the keyboard. Then no menu item can be chosen, but the renamed item is still the one selected.

2. Not every item goes to the renamed file. Action items do: Open, Quick Look, Get Info, Open in Editor, Show in File Manager, Cut, Copy, Copy Path, Copy as Nushell List, Rename…, Duplicate, Make Alias, Make Symbolic Link, Compress, Extract, Move to Trash. Items built with captured values still act on the item the menu names: Open in New Tab, Open in New Window, Open With, Open Nushell Here, Add to Sidebar. So one open menu acts on two different items.

3. The left-click half (click another item, then a key acts on the renamed one, with the highlight showing it) is the part already recorded as left out. The right-click half is the new part. Both column variants hold as described, including the one where a click on the parent folder's row in column 0 ends with column 1 in use again: the rename's load_column completion finds the freshly pushed pane with nothing selected, so `wanted` is selected there and active_column becomes 1. Their evidence: Traced by reading; nothing was run (rules). No guard, reset or early return found on the path.

1. The press ends the edit first. src/finder/inline_rename.rs:262-266 `.on_mouse_down_out(cx.listener(|this, _: &MouseDownEvent, window, cx| { this.leave_rename(window, cx) }))`; gpui-pre-0.3.10 src/elements/div.rs:269-271 runs it in the capture phase for any button. leave_rename (:145-156) -> finish_rename (:123-139) -> src/finder/dialogs.rs:884-887 `if !followed { self.load_listing(vec![target.clone()], true, cx); self.renamed_in_columns(path, target, cx); }`. An unchanged name returns at :852-854 before that.

2. Same press, bubble phase. src/finder/views.rs:488-493 -> src/finder/mod.rs:2677-2685 `self.focus_files(window, cx); if !self.selection.contains(ix) { self.selection.select_only(ix); ... }`. It has no rename check, and `renaming` is None by then anyway (click_row's check at :2648 only stops a refused name). Columns: views.rs:1300-1312 -> select_in_column.

3. The menu is built for the pressed item. gpui-component-0.8.1 src/menu/context_menu.rs:403-406 (bubble, right button, registered before the child so the row's handler runs first) -> open_menu -> :462 `window.defer` -> :474 PopupMenu::build -> src/finder/menus.rs:129-130 `let entries = finder.selected_entries();`, labels at :211-217 `format!("Cut “{}”", first.name)`. The deferred build runs in the same effect cycle as the press, before the listing task can end.

4. The reload then overrides the selection. mod.rs:1545-1557: `this.rebuild_rows(cx);` (which keeps the pressed row by path, :1844 `self.selection.remap(&old, &new)`), then `this.selection.select_only(first); ... this.select_row_in_columns(first, cx);` for the renamed path, whatever is selected by then. Columns: mod.rs:4050-4055 `if first_in_use && first.is_some_and(|pane| pane.selected != Some(ix)) { self.select_in_column_quiet(0, ix, cx); }`; further column mod.rs:4113-4119 `let kept = ...; let wanted = select.as_ref().and_then(position); pane.selected = kept; ... if let Some(ix) = wanted.filter(|ix| kept != Some(*ix)) { this.select_in_column_quiet(col, ix, cx); }`, so the renamed item beats the row just pressed, and select_in_column_quiet sets `self.active_column = col` (:4022).

5. Nothing closes the menu. The kit dismisses it only on a choice, Escape or a press outside (popup_menu.rs:1129-1135), and src/finder has no code that closes a menu when the selection changes (grep).

6. The choice acts on the selection as it is then. menus.rs:322-326 `PopupMenuItem::new("Move to Trash").action(Box::new(MoveToTrash))` -> src/finder/trash.rs:36-40 `let paths: Vec<PathBuf> = self.selected_entries()...`. The same holds for open_selected (mod.rs:3013-3026), get_info, copy_path, reveal, cut_files and copy_files.

History: at c0605b6 load_listing's completion had no select_row_in_columns and load_column took no `select`, so the column kept the pressed row: new in the column view with 7e8df53. Upstream 66c919b already has `this.selection.select_only(first)` (mod.rs:1096) and `self.load_listing(vec![target], true, cx)` (dialogs.rs:853): inherited in list and icons.

Tests: tests/basics.rs:1372-1377 ends a rename with a click on another row and asserts only the new name and that the field is gone. No test pins the selection or opens a menu there.

Records: done/column-pane-selection-by-path.json, left_out, has "A rename ended by a click on another row leaves the renamed item selected, not the clicked one, in the first column and in a further one (probed). The list does the same, by the same code." That is the left-click half, known and left; the reviewer's probe agrees with step 4. The menu that names one item and acts on another is in no done record and not in final-pass-notes.md (line 73 lists a different wrong-item menu, the grey row of an earlier column).
proposal: Reproduce each fault first with a test that fails on the trunk. Then fix it. The finder's suggested fixes, as starting points and not checked plans: [rename-ended-by-press-reselects-renamed-item] Let the reload that follows a rename select the new name only when nothing else has been selected by the time it ends. In load_listing's completion, for a rename's `select`, apply it only if the selection is empty after rebuild_rows has remapped it (the old path is gone from it, so Return and a press on chrome still select the new name; a press on another item keeps that item). In load_column's completion, for the rename's `select`, use `wanted.filter(|_| kept.is_none())`. A flag on the two calls made from submit_rename (dialogs.rs:885-886) is enough; paste, Undo and the Trash keep the present rule.
original_test_plan: The finder's test ideas: [rename-ended-by-press-reselects-renamed-item] tests/basics.rs, list view: ui.select("notes.txt"); ui.press("f2"); ui.type_text("plan"); ui.right_click(item_id("row", &fx.path("Roadmap.md"))); assert_eq!(ui.selected(), ["Roadmap.md"]) (today: ["plan.txt"]); ui.click_menu_item("Move to Trash"); assert!(fx.path("plan.txt").exists()); assert!(!fx.path("Roadmap.md").exists()). The same in view-columns with item_id("crow", ..), once in the first column and once in a further column (projects_with a.txt, b.txt, c.txt: rename b.txt, right-click c.txt). Why the existing tests miss it: [rename-ended-by-press-reselects-renamed-item] tests/basics.rs:1372-1377 ('Clicking somewhere else keeps what was typed') ends a rename with a click on another row and asserts only that the new name exists and the field is gone, not what is selected. The column tests end every rename with Return (tests/basics.rs:1715-1718, 1736-1743). No test opens a menu, or presses a key, after a rename ended by a press. The reviewer of column-pane-selection-by-path probed the left-click case and recorded it as left out.
original_risks: This is a fix late in the branch: keep it to the fault. Every test on the trunk has to keep passing, and the improvements involved (column-pane-selection-by-path) have tests that pin the behaviour around the fault: read their done records in /home/user/polish-tools/done/ before changing the functions they changed.

verifier.claim_check: A second reviewer traced the same path and confirmed it; neither ran anything. Reproduce before changing anything; if a test shows the fault is not there, write the closed record with the evidence and return skipped.

orchestrator_notes: This fault was in the app before this branch, at least in part: write a normal `Changelog (Fixed):` paragraph for what a user of the last release would notice. The full findings, with the second reviewer's evidence line by line, are in /home/user/polish-tools/review/*.md and *.json (search for the finding ids in brackets). The review read the branch at 7e8df53; other changes have landed since, so read the functions as they are now. In the list view this was so before the branch (the reload after a rename selects the new name); 'column-pane-selection-by-path' (7e8df53) made the column view do the same, where before a press on another row left that row selected. Fix it in every view with the one rule. 'stray-double-click-opens-file' (c0605b6) added a record of presses (`Presses`) and 'focus-lost-recovery' (4e5b448) the root's `keyboard_stays`: a press outside the name field ends the edit in the capture phase of that same press; read their done records.
